description: Raised & Hiring, the same list as app.fundz.net/funded-and-hiring: companies with a verified funding round in the last 12 months that have open job postings now, scored and refreshed daily, with the latest round, open postings and exec hires in the last 90 days, and hiring signals. Every company listed has at least one open posting; an exec hire alone does not qualify. Filter by US state, funding series, company name, company size, the role they are hiring (title_family, keyword, department) or new this week. Page through every match with page; use since to get only companies that joined the list on or after a date. To find companies hiring a leadership role, USE title_family (for example title_family "sales_leadership" for "hiring a VP Sales, Head of Sales, Sales Director or CRO"), never a single keyword: titles vary ("VP Sales" returns nothing at a company that posts "Director of Sales"). keyword also takes several titles joined with " OR " or "|". department "Sales" also covers Go-to-market, GTM, Revenue and Business Development.

department.description: Only companies with an open posting in this department. "Sales" also matches Go-to-market, GTM, Revenue, Commercial and Business Development.

employees_max.description: Maximum employee count (same handling of unknown headcount)

employees_min.description: Minimum employee count. Companies with no headcount on file are kept, marked "headcount unknown" and ranked after the known in-range ones.

keyword.description: Only companies with an open posting whose title contains this. Several: "Director of Sales OR Head of Sales".

my_territory.description: Only companies inside the locations of the user's saved filters

new_only.description: Only companies that joined the list in the last 7 days

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). The reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

series.description: Latest funding series, comma-separated, e.g. "Seed, Series A"

since.description: Only companies that joined the list on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01" (sorts newest first)

sort.description: score (default), funding_date (latest round first) or newest (most recently added first)

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code, comma-separated for several, e.g. "Texas, CO"

title_family.description: Title family: one OR set of roles, comma-separated for several. sales_leadership = VP / Vice President / Head of / Director of Sales, Revenue or GTM, plus CRO and Chief Revenue Officer. sales_manager = Sales Manager titles (add it when the user says "sales leaders and managers"). marketing_leadership, engineering_leadership, finance_leadership.

name: search_raised_and_hiring
title: Search Raised & Hiring
